definitions.meaning: A twinkling of an eye, an instant

quotations.old_english: Þonne (at the last day) englas bláwað býman on brehtme (cf. 1 Cor. xv. 52)

source_text: bearhtm. A twinkling of an eye, an instant: Add:--On breahtme in atomo, Wrt. Voc. ii. 79, 27: 46, 60. Þonne (at the last day) englas bláwað býman on brehtme (cf. 1 Cor. xv. 52), Cri. 882.
